item.title: Google's Open-Source Elephant-Goldfish Model Plugin for AI Software Design
item.description: Google open-sourced its internal Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) plugin under Apache 2.0, pairing a no-code long-horizon architect session with stateless adversarial reviewers.

item.title: Google AI Edge Foresight: A Free On-Device AI Meeting Notes App for Mac
item.description: Google’s experimental Mac app AI Edge Foresight transcribes meetings, expands notes, and searches local documents entirely on-device using EmbeddingGemma 2 and Gemma 4.
